company.name: Aaqaraty
company.shortDescription: Aaqaraty is a broker-first platform that transforms how real estate professionals connect, collaborate, and close deals in emerging markets.
company.description: Aaqaraty is a property management software platform designed for real estate professionals, property owners, tenants, and service providers. The platform provides tools for managing residential and commercial properties through a centralized cloud-based dashboard. Its features include lease and contract management, rent collection, invoicing, payment reminders, maintenance request tracking, financial reporting, and role-based access management.
